name: 修仙世界
english_description: A small original FluffOS cultivation MUD (修仙世界) by Nuiio, set on Qingyun Sect (青云宗). New characters pick a dao-name and awaken one of eight spirit roots, then start on the sect square with twelve linked areas (training hall, scripture pavilion, alchemy room, quest hall, herb garden, weapon shop, back hill, mountain gate, wilds, forest, cave). Play is Chinese look/score/xiulian/quit; eleven realms from mortal through immortal. Not the xxcq/xxcqii lineage.
